children: Thinkific Labs laid off 96 employees as part of a reorganization to spur growth in its Thinkific Plus offering for mid-market and enterprise customers.

The Canadian online learnings platform said the reorganization will generate around $19 million in gross annualized cost savings. Most of the cost reductions will be recognized in the fourth quarter with some non-headcount savings recognized in the first quarter of 2027.
The restructuring is also expected to materially improve the company's free cash flow margin in fiscal 2027.
Thinkific said it expects to incur around $5 million in charges related to the restructuring, largely in the third quarter.

"The reorganization will allow Thinkific to invest more in products serving its highest value-customers, continue growing its upmarket customer base and business, and focus R&D efforts on building new enterprise-first innovation, while maintaining support for all of Thinkific's valued customers," the company said Wednesday.

Thinkific also raised its outlook for third-quarter adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization to a range of 7% to 10% of revenue, up from its previous guidance for 2% to 5% of revenue. The guidance excludes restructuring costs.
The company backed its prior guidance for third-quarter revenue between $18.6 million and $18.9 million. It said revenue in the quarter-to-date is trending toward the upper end of the range.
